joli_bookings.name: Rachel Jovanovic
joli_bookings.feedback: Loved the food and the staff were so nice!

joli_bookings.name: Titi Asu
joli_bookings.feedback: Hello Joli_App Team, Thank you for the opportunity. I wanted to share some honest and constructive feedback following my visit. *Overall Impression:* The experience started with mixed feelings, warmed up midway, but unfortunately soured at the end, leaving my guest and I feeling like unwanted guests. *Arrival & Initial Engagement:* We were met and seated by a waitress. I introduced myself and showed the booking confirmation email. She advised she would need to check with the manager and took pictures of the confirmation. We were then moved to a larger table to allow more space for capturing content, which was appreciated. However, unlike previous creator visits I’ve done at other locations, there was no introduction or acknowledgement from the Manager at any point during our visit. *Service:* There was some confusion around the drinks order — we didn’t immediately realise the particular wine we enquired about was not available by the glass, so it was assumed we wanted the bottle. We then chose an alternative. Throughout service there were long waiting periods, and on more than one occasion food was placed on the table with a brief announcement and no warmth, smile or engagement. *Departure:* As we were full and did not want to waste food while also leaving room for dessert, we asked if a few dishes could be packaged to go. We were told takeaway was not offered, which was confusing as we observed several delivery drivers collecting takeaway orders from the same pass during our visit. We finished dessert and attempted to say goodbye to the Manager who was at the bar area near the exit. We informed him we were leaving, but he simply nodded and looked away. As we were leaving, we were stopped by the exit by the same waitress who asked to see the confirmation message again, despite having already taken pictures of it on arrival. She explained she needed to verify the handle via the Joli app, which would not open due to poor network reception in that area. After several unsuccessful attempts, we left unceremoniously. She then went directly to the Manager. Overall, the final interaction left us feeling awkward and unappreciated. I share this feedback constructively, with the intention of helping improve the creator and guest experience.

joli_bookings.name: Ashley Meakin

joli_bookings.name: Pia Isip
joli_bookings.feedback: The food was phenomenal! Especially when accompanied with superb service, thank you Mia & Gracie for being so attentive and helpful. Just to note that there was some slight confusion on the bill with another member of staff - we were mid conversation with Gracie asking for a to-go box and ordering a dessert, when the staff in question dropped the bill right in front of us, faced Gracie and proceeded to talk about us as if we weren't right there 'they're influencers or something i dont know how it works' and then as we were looking at him confused as we were in the middle of a conversation, he asked us 'what do you wanna pay for' - I think this is just something that could be finetuned to make the collaboration smoother and avoid any misunderstandings!

joli_bookings.feedback: I was kindly invited to Maki Ramen in Leeds, and we started with refreshing mocktails followed by some delicious starters — prawn tempura and vegetable gyoza. 🍹✨ For the mains, we tried the chicken green curry ramen and the beef ramen, and of course, we had to try the sushi too — spicy tuna rolls, green dragon rolls, and salmon & avocado rolls. 🍜🍣 Everything was packed with flavour, beautifully presented, and genuinely so good! joli_bookings.name: Chevon Samuel
joli_bookings.feedback: We had such an amazing evening! From the moment we arrived, the service was spectacular, we felt so welcomed and genuinely looked after throughout the whole night. The food was even better, there wasn’t a single thing we ordered that we didn’t love. As parents, getting the chance to properly switch off, dress up and enjoy a date night together is always special, and this was honestly such a lovely one. We ate, laughed, talked and just enjoyed having that time together. It was one of those evenings where you leave feeling really happy that you went. We’ll definitely be back! ❤️
